label: row_0
context: This table summarizes pKa values for substituted primary alcohols. Electron-withdrawing α-substituents (e.g., CF₃, CCl₃) lower pKa by inductive stabilization of the alkoxide. π systems such as allyl and propargyl show little effect because the alkoxide is not conjugated with the π system, so resonance does not stabilize the anion. The trend indicates that alcohol acidity is governed mainly by through-bond inductive effects.
